tasks.title: BayReady: Chat home tiles Appointment status and Today's services show nothing when tapped
tasks.brief:
Evidence: Chanh, real RO page, v3.21: tap tile Appointment status or Today's services and nothing appears (no user line, no error). Find a car works. Code path: content.js home tile handler (search w.querySelectorAll('.tile')) -> runJob('builtin-xtime-status' or 'builtin-xtime-day') = post({type:'run_route', id}); background.js case 'run_route' -> runRouteTask(...).catch(() => {}) (silent); routes.js runRouteTaskInner has `if (!route) return;` (silent); runRouteTask/waitQuiet/withSched can wait before the first addLog so the tap shows nothing meanwhile. Say which suspect it was: 1) port to background dead (stale tab), 2) route id not found, 3) wait before first log, 4) error swallowed by .catch.
Done when this passes: Start from repo giusemc1988/bayready main (v3.21.4), branch tiles-fix, bump to 3.21.5, change ONLY content.js/background.js/routes.js as needed. 1) node scripts/bayready-gate.mjs (from stock-predict) prints GATE: green. 2) Tapping each of the two tiles shows a user line at once, then the result or a clear error message within 5 s (never silent). Do NOT release, do NOT touch bayready-latest.zip, do NOT merge: open a PR and write PR:, GATE:, and the suspect number in the RESULT file.
tasks.progress: picked up T18 (bayready tiles show nothing when tapped); reading the tile path in content.js/background.js/routes.js from main v3.21.4
tasks.result: DONE PR: https://github.com/giusemc1988/bayready/pull/5 GATE: green Suspect: 3 (wait before first log) BayReady 3.21.5 (from main 3.21.4, branch tiles-fix). Tapping Appointment status or Today's services showed nothing: runRouteTaskInner waited in waitQuiet (silent up to 7.5s for a background TIS read) before the first user line, and the content.js 5s safety net never fired because state.running was already true from that TIS read. Changed only content.js, routes.js (+ manifest/changelog version bump). routes.js: route lookup and the user line now run before waitQuiet, so a tap shows its line at once; a missing route errors at once too. content.js: the 5s runJob timer now fires on no-log alone, even when state.running is already true. Checks (real output): node --check OK on content.js, routes.js, background.js. Verification test (vm harness, ~/workspace/bayready-work/v3215-test/test-tiles-fix.js): 7/7 pass — user line before waitQuiet for both tiles, missing route errors at once without waiting, 5s alert fires even when state.running is true. node bayready-gate.mjs (stock-predict, --prev 3.21.4 manifest): GATE: green. Not released, bayready-latest.zip untouched, not merged (reviewer merges per pipeline). LESSON: A "did not start" safety timer must check only whether anything was logged, never whether the panel already looks busy — a background read sets running=true, so a timer gated on !running never fires and the tap stays silent.

tasks.title: BayReady: page timers keep running and throwing after the extension is updated (stale tab)
tasks.brief:
Evidence: content.js has 17 setInterval calls that run for the life of the page (e.g. lines ~4823 roslot refresh, ~6848 tload bars, ~7368 cvPreScanBar, ~7493 RO watcher, ~5326 port ping). Only one watcher (staleIv, ~line 4262) notices the extension was updated (chrome.runtime.id gone) and it only shows a banner and hides the panel; the other timers keep firing and call chrome.runtime.sendMessage / chrome.storage, which throw 'Extension context invalidated' every tick on every stale tab.
Done when this passes: Branch stale-timers from repo giusemc1988/bayready main (v3.21.4), bump to 3.21.6 only if 3.21.5 (task tiles fix) is not yet in main, otherwise 3.21.5+1. Change ONLY content.js. When staleIv sees the context is dead it must clear every page timer (e.g. route page timers through one helper that records ids, then clear them all there). Do not reload the tab automatically (3.21.3 rule: never reload a tab the user may be typing in). Gate: node scripts/bayready-gate.mjs (from stock-predict) prints GATE: green and tests/enrich-pick.test.js still passes if it runs. Do NOT release, do NOT touch bayready-latest.zip, do NOT merge: open a PR and write PR:, GATE: and the list of timers you routed through the helper in the RESULT file.
